title: Salons
lead: All salons with subscription status. Billing is manual: you set plan and status here.
more: There are more salons. Narrow the search.
loadFailed: The salons could not be loaded.
planHint: Decides how many staff members can be added (Solo 1, Team 5, Salon Plus 15). During the trial the limit of the biggest plan applies.
statusHint: Suspended, cancelled and expired salons can only read; the booking page says “not available” with the phone number.
trialHint: Extends from the later of today and the current end. The reminder mails go out again.
noteHint: Only you can see it, e.g. billing agreements. Do not enter customer data.
